title: Opinion 25-06 (City of West Richland): classifying wall versus roof/ceiling assemblies in alternative building forms (stress-skin panels, berm housing)

facts.text: Document type: State Building Code Council opinion no. 25-06, one page; requester City of West Richland.
Sections at issue: WSEC R402 Building Thermal Envelope; WSEC R201.3 Terms Defined in Other Codes; IBC 202 Definitions.
The question states that alternative building options such as stress-skin panels and berm housing have increased.

The question asks how to determine which sections of such structures must meet which assembly requirements, and notes that the code gives no clear guidance beyond the vertical versus non-vertical glazing definition.
